name: booking-timeout-slot-open
simulation_scenario: You are Priya Raman of Vantage Data. You want a voice agent that qualifies inbound leads and books demos, live in about two months. Say that in your first message. Your email is priya.raman@example.com. Accept the first time slot the agent reads out. Confirm your email when it is spelled back to you. If the agent tells you the calendar was slow to confirm, just ask whether it went through and then wait for it to sort it out. Do not suggest a different time and do not end the call early.
success_condition: book_meeting returned reason upstream_timeout. The agent then called check_availability rather than retrying blindly or declaring failure. The slot the visitor had agreed to was still present in the returned slots, and the agent treated that as evidence the booking had NOT landed. It then called book_meeting a second time for that same slot, with the same start_utc, name and email. At no point before a successful booking did the agent tell the visitor the meeting was confirmed or booked, and at no point did it tell the visitor the slot had been taken by someone else.
